summary: Validated SDK-compatibility regression scope on public preview URL. Frontend preview loads and Home -> Generate Horoscope navigation works. Backend health is healthy and core pytest suite passes except one TTL-index state check.

critical.issue: TTL index `expires_at_1` (expireAfterSeconds: 0) still exists in DB state, even though startup code no longer creates TTL indexes.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: props.pointerEvents deprecated; use style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Drop legacy TTL index `expires_at_1` on `user_sessions` via one-time migration if TTL removal is required in production behavior.
Keep app-level expiry logic (already verified): expired session token returns 401 on /api/auth/me.
Optional cleanup: resolve React Native deprecation warnings (`shadow*`, `pointerEvents`).
critical_code_review_comments: Startup code review confirmed no TTL index creation calls (no `expireAfterSeconds` in auth.py/server.py).
Both backend auth and main server currently bind DB with load_dotenv before auth import in server.py; DB split issue from prior iteration is resolved.
Backend still uses env fallbacks for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME in code; strict env-only fail-fast would be safer for deployment consistency.
seed_data_creation: Pytest seeds temporary users/sessions for auth/profile tests and cleans up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SDK is resolved at 54.0.0 (expo config). Expo doctor passed 18/18. Public /api/health is healthy. One failing check is DB state: pre-existing TTL index on user_sessions remains.
rca_of_issue: RCA: Not a startup-code regression. Code no longer creates TTL index, but MongoDB still contains a historical `expires_at_1` TTL index (expireAfterSeconds:0). Reproduced via `db.user_sessions.index_information()` during this run. Mitigation: perform one-time index drop migration if TTL behavior must be fully removed.
